statements.markdown:
For the perturbed wave, Lemma 2.7 shows that at late times $
u_+$ is close to $
u$ and $\eta_+/
u_+$ is comparable to $\cos\varphi$. Under the hypotheses of Proposition 2.8, the ratio reaches the prescribed value after the amplitude peaks in the strong-shear limit, while the new shear remains large. We start the successor when the ratio reaches that threshold. Thus the Craik–Criminale equations produce both amplification and the orientation needed to repeat the construction.
